as_told.title: C-van briefing on the gray project inside the black project

plain: A former US Air Force sergeant, Dan Sherman, says that in the early 1990s he was briefed about what he calls a "gray project" hidden inside a "black project", meaning a secret programme tucked inside another secret programme so only a few people in it knew. He says an officer named Captain White told him this, connected to the NSA, the US spy agency that intercepts communications, and that his own job was to communicate with non-human beings. On Jesse Michels's podcast he places the briefing at NSA headquarters in Maryland in one telling and in a communications van at an overseas post in another.
